crossRefs.note: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a…
Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
Her rival provoked her severely, to irritate her, because Yahweh had shut up her womb.
So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.

translations.web: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.
translations.bsb: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.
translations.kjv: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
translations.asv: Surely there are mockers with me, And mine eye dwelleth upon their provocation.
